cues: In autumn they dig a vegetable garden, and the garden brings the neighbours to the fence with advice.
The young man resents it, but, tellingly, he takes careful note of what is said.
His wife is bolder: she runs a hand over the little boy's shaved head, and the big woman next door gives her garlic to plant.
